name: Pentagonal Obstruction
definition: On the cyclic ground set $[5]$, take the empty set, all five singletons, the five edges of $C_5$, and the five complements of those edges. In low-bit integer encoding the family is $\{0,1,2,3,4,6,7,8,12,14,16,17,19,24,25,28\}$.
properties: A sixteen-vertex maximum and ample class of VC dimension two and isometric dimension five. It has a corner peeling but no peripheral coordinate; every elementary pc-minor belongs to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$. Thus it is an ample pc-minimal obstruction and witnesses $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}\subsetneq\mathcal D_{\mathrm{amp}}$.
